instruction: Access https://github.com/xlang-ai/instructor-embedding and download the repository to /home/user.

metadata.explanation: Task requires downloading the instructor-embedding repository to /home/user. Evaluator verifies the download was successful by checking: (1) file count is between 50-500, (2) .git directory exists, (3) repository-specific files exist (setup.py, requirements.txt, README.md), and (4) InstructorEmbedding directory exists. This ensures a complete git clone of the correct repository.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: Properly counts files using 'find -type f', checks for .git directory, verifies required files (setup.py, requirements.txt, README.md), and checks for InstructorEmbedding directory. All bash commands handle errors gracefully with 2>/dev/null

Metric comparison logic is correct: Checks all requirements - file count range (50-500), .git directory existence, all required files, and all required directories. Returns 1.0 only when all checks pass, 0.0 otherwise

Complete instruction coverage: Evaluator verifies (1) repository was cloned via git (.git directory check), (2) it's the correct repository (repository-specific files/dirs), and (3) download was complete (file count range)
Data flow is correct: Getter extracts exactly what metric needs - file_count, has_git_dir, required_files_exist dict, required_dirs_exist dict. Metric properly accesses all components
Parameter handling is correct: Metric properly accesses expected.get('min_count', 50) since when expected.type='rule', the framework passes the rules dict directly as the expected parameter

Expected values are semantically correct: min_count=50 and max_count=500 are reasonable for a Python repository; required_files (setup.py, requirements.txt, README.md) are standard Python repository files; required_dirs (InstructorEmbedding, .git) verify repository identity and git clone
No state timing issues: File operations persist after task completion, no postconfig needed. All checks access stable filesystem state
All previous issues fixed: Previous judgment identified min_count=5 as too low, missing .git check, missing repository identity verification - all have been addressed
